title: HydroPulse v2.0.8 - Zero-Mock Clean DB, Accurate Dual-Node MQTT Heartbeat & API Rate Limiting
changelog: Database Reset: Completely flushed all pre-existing database records, mock users, and hardware devices. All accounts start with zero hardware.
Zero-Mock Policy: Completely removed default dummy hardware creation and arbitrary MQTT auto-adoption across the mobile app.
Accurate Dual-Node Monitoring: Independent real-time tracking for Main Gateway (ESP32) and Sub Node (ESP8266 Tank Level Sensor) with live status badges.
Hardware Heartbeat Watchdog: Sub-second ping probes with 6-second true offline detection and gateway RF link status reporting.
API Security & Rate Limiting: Sliding-window rate limiters across auth, command, and general endpoints with security response headers.
